toasts.redeliveryQueued: Redelivery queued under the original webhook id

emptyState.title: Get notified when async jobs finish
emptyState.description: Register webhook endpoints and Bifrost will send a signed notification whenever an async inference job completes or fails, so you don't have to poll for results.

view.title: Webhooks
view.subtitle: Register endpoints to receive signed notifications when async inference jobs complete or fail. Pass the endpoint's name in the <1>x-bf-async-webhook</1> header when submitting a job.

deleteDialog.title: Delete webhook endpoint
deleteDialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete <1>{{name}}</1>? Pending deliveries to it will be dropped and jobs referencing it will be rejected. This action cannot be undone.

rotateDialog.title: Rotate signing secret
rotateDialog.description: The current secret for <1>{{name}}</1> stops working immediately and deliveries are signed with the new one from now on. Update your receiver right after rotating.

secretDialog.title: Signing secret for {{name}}
secretDialog.description: Use this secret to verify the <1>webhook-signature</1> header on deliveries. It is shown only once - copy it now and store it securely. If you lose it, rotate the endpoint to get a new one.

sheet.editDescription: Update the endpoint's URL, subscriptions, and delivery behavior.
sheet.createDescription: Register an HTTPS endpoint to receive signed notifications when async jobs finish.
sheet.includeResponseDescription: Inline the job's result in the notification. Oversized or already-expired results are delivered as a thin payload instead.
sheet.allowPrivateNetworkDescription: Permit deliveries to private IP ranges. Only enable this for receivers inside your own network.
sheet.headersNote: Sent with every delivery. Signing and content headers are reserved and cannot be overridden.
sheet.tuningNote: If retries extend past the job's result TTL, later deliveries carry a thin payload marked <1>result_expired</1>.

max_retries.label: Max retries
max_retries.description: Retries after the first delivery attempt.

retry_backoff_initial_seconds.label: Initial retry backoff (seconds)
retry_backoff_initial_seconds.description: Delay before the first retry; doubles per retry.

attempt_timeout_seconds.label: Attempt timeout (seconds)
attempt_timeout_seconds.description: End-to-end bound for one delivery attempt.

max_response_payload_kbs.label: Max response payload (KB)
max_response_payload_kbs.description: Responses above this size are omitted from the payload.

max_concurrent_deliveries.label: Max concurrent deliveries
max_concurrent_deliveries.description: Concurrent in-flight deliveries to this endpoint per node.

validation.eventsMin: Subscribe to at least one event
validation.privateNetworkRequired: http:// URLs require "Allow private network" to be enabled

statusTooltip.retrying: <1>retrying</1>: transient failure (network error, timeout, 429, or 5xx); another attempt is scheduled.
statusTooltip.failed: <1>failed</1>: permanent error (a non-retryable 4xx such as 401/404); not retried automatically.
statusTooltip.retriesExhausted: <1>retries exhausted</1>: kept failing until the retry budget ran out.

details.responsesTooltip: One chip per delivery attempt, oldest to newest: the receiver's response code, or a dash when no response arrived. Hover a failed code for its error.
details.loadError: Failed to load delivery history. Retrying…
